summary: 62-year-old woman sustained lower-leg and arm injuries while hiking on the Yankee Doodle trail near Winter Park; carried out on a litter and transferred to an ambulance.
location: Yankee Doodle trail near Winter Park, Grand County
notes: Second of two 2020-07-04 missions described in the same post; call came in ~1:00pm. Litter carry-out before 3:00pm. Distinct from the same-day Leland Creek trail bicycle accident.
